$comment: Callouts over the 3D track. `status: personal` is Yona's own words: rewrite freely. Facts about the track carry a source. scrollRange is in vh from the top of #track and is matched against the centre of the viewport, so a range sits 50vh after the camera hold it belongs to (see SCHEDULE in src/track/world.ts). Ranges must be >= 60vh and must not overlap.

bubbles.text: Hi, I'm Yona. I run, and I build things for the web. This page is one lap of a track, so keep scrolling and run it with me.
That's me in lane 1. I run for the quiet, for the stubborn joy of a hard session, and for the number on the watch at the end.
A standard track is two 84.39 m straights joined by two bends with a 36.5 m radius. Once round lane 1 is 400 m.
Most tracks have eight lanes, each 1.22 m wide. Outer lanes are longer round the bends, which is why a 400 m race starts staggered.
Past the line you'll find my personal records, my best race, my bike and camera, and the other things I've built.
